verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents case management where analysts review alerts and select a case decision ('no risk detected', 'risk detected- accepted', 'risk detected- offboard'). An API endpoint returns the audit log trail for a case, so decisions are part of a recorded case history. Nothing in the evidence shows analysts can add free-text notes, attach evidence, or record a written reason for a decision. Missing for 10: documented notes/comments on cases, evidence or file attachments, free-text decision rationale, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the investigation history.
